/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var | sub => grind
  case app | tapp =>
    cases lc <;>
      grind (gen := 2) only [→ canonical_form_abs, → canonical_form_tabs,
        → Red.abs, → Red.tabs, → Red.appₗ, → Red.appᵣ, → Red.tapp]
  case let' | case =>
    grind (gen := 2) only [body_let, body_case, → canonical_form_sum,
      → Red.let_body, → Red.let_bind, → Red.case_inl, → Red.case_inr, → Red.case]
  all_goals grind only [Value, → wf, → Red.inl, → Red.inr]
EOF
python tools.py profile candidate.lean --threshold-raw 300000 --limit 12; python tools.py read Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/Typing.lean --start 34 --end 90"

35: /-- The typing relation. -/
36: inductive Typing : Env Var → Term Var → Ty Var → Prop
37:   | var : Γ.Wf → Binding.ty σ ∈ Γ.dlookup x → Typing Γ (fvar x) σ
38:   | abs (L : Finset Var) :
39:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
40:       Typing Γ (abs σ t₁) (arrow σ τ)
41:   | app : Typing Γ t₁ (arrow σ τ) → Typing Γ t₂ σ → Typing Γ (app t₁ t₂) τ
42:   | tabs (L : Finset Var) :
43:       (∀ X ∉ L, Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (τ ^ᵞ fvar X)) →
44:       Typing Γ (tabs σ t₁) (all σ τ)
45:   | tapp : Typing Γ t₁ (all σ τ) → Sub Γ σ' σ → Typing Γ (tapp t₁ σ') (τ ^ᵞ σ')
46:   | sub : Typing Γ t τ → Sub Γ τ τ' → Typing Γ t τ'
47:   | let' (L : Finset Var) :
48:       Typing Γ t₁ σ →
49:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
50:       Typing Γ (let' t₁ t₂) τ
51:   | inl : Typing Γ t₁ σ → τ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inl t₁) (sum σ τ)
52:   | inr : Typing Γ t₁ τ → σ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inr t₁) (sum σ τ)
53:   | case (L : Finset Var) :
54:       Typing Γ t₁ (sum σ τ) →
55:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
56:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Γ) (t₃ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
57:       Typing Γ (case t₁ t₂ t₃) δ
58: 
59: namespace Typing
60: 
61: variable {Γ Δ Θ : Env Var} {σ τ δ : Ty Var}
62: 
63: attribute [grind .] Typing.var Typing.app Typing.tapp Typing.sub Typing.inl Typing.inr
64: 
65: set_option linter.tacticAnalysis.verifyGrindOnly false in
66: /-- Typings have well-formed contexts and types. -/
67: @[grind →]
68: lemma wf {Γ : Env Var} {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Var} (der : Typing Γ t τ) : Γ.Wf ∧ t.LC ∧ τ.Wf Γ := by
69:   induction der <;> let L := free_union Var <;> have ⟨x, nmem⟩ := fresh_exists L
70:   case tabs ih =>
71:     cases (ih x (by grind)).left
72:     split_ands
73:     · grind
74:     · apply LC.tabs L <;> grind
75:     · apply Ty.Wf.all L <;> grind
76:   case abs ih =>
77:     cases (ih x (by grind)).left
78:     grind [LC.abs L, Wf.strengthen]
79:   case let' => grind [LC.let' L, Ty.Wf.strengthen]
80:   case case => refine ⟨?_, LC.case L ?_ ?_ ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind [Ty.Wf.strengthen]
81:   case var => grind [of_bind_ty]
82:   case app => grind only [LC.app, cases Ty.Wf]
83:   all_goals grind [open_lc]
84: 
85: /-- Weakening of typings. -/
86: lemma weaken (der : Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).Wf) :
87:     Typing (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ) t τ := by
88:   generalize eq : Γ ++ Δ = ΓΔ at der
89:   induction der generalizing Γ
90:   case' abs => apply abs ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var)", "truncated": false}
